source_sheet: Engineering-as-Marketing | Funding Tools and Financial Calculators
purpose: White-label engineering-as-marketing tool directory for funding calculators, quizzes, analyzers, prompts, and workflow assets.
front_end_note: Public UI should use public fields only. Do not expose internal.affiliate_partner, internal.core_logic, or internal routing notes unless intentionally building an admin view.

items.name: The Premium Finance Gap Calculator
items.description: Help losing policy renewals because clients cannot afford the 20-30% premium down payment and generate a Policy-Bound Checklist & Funding Quote (PDF).
items.use_case: Losing policy renewals because clients cannot afford the 20-30% premium down payment.

internal.core_logic: Calculates (Total Premium * Down Payment %) - Available Cash to find the exact financing gap.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Urgent Tax Advance Estimator
items.description: Help clients owe IRS, risk penalties, and lack the liquid cash to pay and generate a IRS Protection Advance Estimate (Summary).
items.use_case: Clients owe IRS, risk penalties, and lack the liquid cash to pay.

internal.core_logic: Advance = Avg Rev * 0.5 to 1.5; Penalty Savings = Est. Tax * 0.005 * Months Past Due.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Gig Income Funding Predictor ("Giggle Finance")
items.description: Help need instant funding predictions based on app revenue without hard credit pulls and generate a Back on the Road Funding Score.
items.use_case: Need instant funding predictions based on app revenue without hard credit pulls.

internal.core_logic: Avg Weekly Earnings * 4, modified by a seniority factor (e.g., *1.2 for 2+ years).
internal.output_artifact: Back on the Road Funding Score
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The NECA Material Money Quoter
items.description: Help winning a contract but lacking the upfront cash flow to buy materials before the first draw and generate a Project Material Finance Bridge Quote (PDF).
items.use_case: Winning a contract but lacking the upfront cash flow to buy materials before the first draw.

internal.core_logic: Advance = Estimated Material Cost (capped at 25% of total job value or $50k).
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Turndown Retrieval" Script Generator
items.description: Help bank officers are throwing away rejected leads and losing out on commissions and generate a Turndown Retrieval Script (Copy-Paste Text).
items.use_case: Bank officers are throwing away rejected leads and losing out on commissions.

internal.core_logic: Inserts agent and bank branch names into a dynamic "50/50 commission split" pitch script.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Blue Collar Banker Lead Qualifier
items.description: Help agents wasting time pitching non-fundable leads and generate a Fundability Scorecard (Image).
items.use_case: Agents wasting time pitching non-fundable leads.

internal.core_logic: Deducts points from 100% for each missed underwriting minimum (Revenue, FICO, Time in Business).
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Daily Commission Projection Dashboard
items.description: Help need immediate, motivational calculations of daily earning potential and generate a Daily Paycheck Goal Tracker (Dashboard).
items.use_case: Need immediate, motivational calculations of daily earning potential.

internal.core_logic: Target Goal / Avg Commission = Deals Needed; Deals * 5 = Required Weekly Leads.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Auto-Repair Emergency Advance Tool
items.description: Help car breaks down, and no cash for repairs means no ability to earn income and generate a Emergency Repair Funding Auth (SMS Link).
items.use_case: Car breaks down, and no cash for repairs means no ability to earn income.

internal.core_logic: Funds up to 100% of the repair estimate, capped at $5,000 based on ride history.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) Repayment Estimator
items.description: Help uncertainty about how daily MCA deductions will impact operating cash flow and generate a Daily Cash Flow Impact Report (Table).
items.use_case: Uncertainty about how daily MCA deductions will impact operating cash flow.

internal.core_logic: Total Repayment = Advance * Factor Rate; Daily Payment = Total Repayment / 90.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Competitor "Meet or Beat" Submitter
items.description: Help skepticism about rates and predatory terms from other lenders and generate a Risk-Free Guarantee Certificate.
items.use_case: Skepticism about rates and predatory terms from other lenders.

internal.core_logic: Captures competitor offer and verifies qualification for the $500 "Beat It" guarantee.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Referral Commission Payout Estimator
items.description: Help affiliates want transparent expectations on exact commission payouts and generate a Daily Commission Snapshot (Chart).
items.use_case: Affiliates want transparent expectations on exact commission payouts.

internal.core_logic: Client Funding Amount * Base Rate (Adjusted by New/Bronze/Silver tier).
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Buy-Here-Pay-Here Down Payment Bridge
items.description: Help customer is short on a vehicle down payment, killing the car sale and generate a Vehicle Deposit Authorization (Voucher).
items.use_case: Customer is short on a vehicle down payment, killing the car sale.

internal.core_logic: Vehicle Down Payment Required - Customer Cash Available (Capped at $1,500).
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Trade Association Profit-Split Calculator
items.description: Help associations need non-dues revenue streams and generate a Association Revenue Projection Dashboard.
items.use_case: Associations need non-dues revenue streams.

internal.core_logic: Members * 5% Funding Rate * Avg Amount * 1% Override = Annual Revenue.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Credit Score vs. Cash Flow Analyzer
items.description: Help feeling penalized by traditional banks for low FICO scores despite strong revenue and generate a Bankability Shift Report (Image).
items.use_case: Feeling penalized by traditional banks for low FICO scores despite strong revenue.

internal.core_logic: Compares FICO (<600 = Bank Fail) against Monthly Deposits (>$5k = Breezy Pass).
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Cold Lead Monetization Calculator
items.description: Help throwing away rejected lease applications instead of monetizing them and generate a Lost Commission Recovery Report.
items.use_case: Throwing away rejected lease applications instead of monetizing them.

internal.core_logic: Rejected Leads * 15% Conversion * Avg Amount * 3% Comm * Split.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Payroll Bridge Funding Quoter
items.description: Help client Net-30 payments are delayed, and Friday payroll must be met and generate a Weekly Payroll Liquidity Plan.
items.use_case: Client Net-30 payments are delayed, and Friday payroll must be met.

internal.core_logic: Recommends an advance equal to Total Weekly Payroll * 2 (up to $100k).
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Trucker Repair-to-Revenue Tracker
items.description: Help expensive truck repairs halt cash flow, causing panic and generate a Repair ROI Timeline (Chart).
items.use_case: Expensive truck repairs halt cash flow, causing panic.

internal.core_logic: Calculates Days to Recover = Repair Cost / (Avg Weekly Revenue / 7).
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Passive Income Network Builder
items.description: Help needs to see the exponential power of recruiting sub-agents to build downlines and generate a 3-Tier Override Projection (Table).
items.use_case: Needs to see the exponential power of recruiting sub-agents to build downlines.

internal.core_logic: (Recruits * 4) * Avg T1 Commission * 0.5% override = Tier 2/3 Est.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Bank Firing" Risk Score
items.description: Help risk of rejection due to tightening Tier-1 banking standards and generate a Traditional Bank Risk Score.
items.use_case: Risk of rejection due to tightening Tier-1 banking standards.

internal.core_logic: Deducts points from 100 for <$250k Rev or <700 FICO. Score <50 = 85% Rejection Risk.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Equipment Leasing Deposit Calculator
items.description: Help customers cannot afford the initial large security deposit for equipment leases and generate a Equipment Lease Deposit Bridge Quote.
items.use_case: Customers cannot afford the initial large security deposit for equipment leases.

internal.core_logic: Advance = Required Lease Deposit/Payment (capped at $25,000).
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Same-Day vs. 60-Day Cost Analyzer
items.description: Help waiting 60 days for a cheap bank loan costs more in lost revenue than a fast, expensive loan and generate a Opportunity Cost Report.
items.use_case: Waiting 60 days for a cheap bank loan costs more in lost revenue than a fast, expensive loan.

internal.core_logic: Average Daily Revenue * Days Lost Waiting for Bank = Revenue Lost.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Tax Prep Fee Advance Solution
items.description: Help clients need cash for their IRS tax bill and the preparer's fee and generate a Tax Preparation Fee Guarantee (Voucher).
items.use_case: Clients need cash for their IRS tax bill and the preparer's fee.

internal.core_logic: Advances the Tax Preparation Fee (up to $2,500) directly to the preparer's account.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Bad Credit, Good Business" Certifier
items.description: Help psychological discouragement from prior rejections and generate a Good Business Certificate (Image).
items.use_case: Psychological discouragement from prior rejections.

internal.core_logic: If Months of Positive Cash Flow > 6, it overrides FICO and outputs a "Pass".
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Service Industry Tip-to-Revenue Translator
items.description: Help need to quantify credit card tips to prove steady revenue capacity to underwriters and generate a Credit Card Tip Flow Analysis.
items.use_case: Need to quantify credit card tips to prove steady revenue capacity to underwriters.

internal.core_logic: Repayment Capacity = (Daily CC Tip Rev + Daily CC Sale Rev) * 0.15.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The NECA Endorsement Value Illustrator
items.description: Help skepticism regarding alternative lender trust and generate a Trust & Approval Rating (Gauge).
items.use_case: Skepticism regarding alternative lender trust.

internal.core_logic: Outputs a high trust factor based on national trade association (NECA) backing.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Competitor Rate-to-Factor Rate Translator
items.description: Help confusion comparing traditional time-based APRs to fixed MCA Factor Rates and generate a Loan Terms Comparison Table.
items.use_case: Confusion comparing traditional time-based APRs to fixed MCA Factor Rates.

internal.core_logic: Translates Factor Rate (e.g., 1.18) to "$1.18 paid for every $1.00 borrowed".
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Cash Flow Gap Bridge Calculator
items.description: Help finding the minimum MCA needed to cover immediate payroll/invoice gaps in under 60 seconds and generate a Emergency Funding Requirement (PDF).
items.use_case: Finding the minimum MCA needed to cover immediate payroll/invoice gaps in under 60 seconds.

internal.core_logic: Cash Flow Gap Amount * 1.25 (Factor Buffer) = Needed MCA.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Fix-and-Flip ROI & Max Loan Estimator
items.description: Help hard money deal analysis to find max loan amount and potential ROI and generate a Deal Profitability Scorecard (PDF).
items.use_case: Hard money deal analysis to find max loan amount and potential ROI.

internal.core_logic: Max Loan = ARV * 0.75 LTV (Aligns with Hard Money limits).
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Startup Funding Eligibility Quiz
items.description: Help brand new businesses (0 months) need pre-qualification without business history and generate a 70-Second Eligibility Score.
items.use_case: Brand new businesses (0 months) need pre-qualification without business history.

internal.core_logic: If FICO > 700 & Tradelines >= 5 -> Green Light (Startup Loan). Else -> Credit Incubator.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Bank-Rejected" Second Look Finder
items.description: Help identifying viable alternatives after a rigid traditional bank denial and generate a Second-Chance Funding Match (PDF).
items.use_case: Identifying viable alternatives after a rigid traditional bank denial.

internal.core_logic: Maps bank rejection reasons (e.g., Tax Lien, Time in Biz) to GoKapital's lenient products.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Real Estate Proof of Funds (POF) Generator
items.description: Help need an instant Proof of Funds letter to submit aggressive real estate offers and generate a Conditional Pre-Qualification Letter.
items.use_case: Need an instant Proof of Funds letter to submit aggressive real estate offers.

internal.core_logic: Generates a conditional pre-qualification up to 80% LTV of the input offer amount.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: SBA Denial Pivot Tool
items.description: Help cannot wait the 1-3 months required for SBA 7(a) loan approval and generate a Fast Funding Alternatives Checklist.
items.use_case: Cannot wait the 1-3 months required for SBA 7(a) loan approval.

internal.core_logic: If time <30 days, pivots to MCA/Term. If >90 days, anchors to SBA with a Term alternative.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Bad Credit Business Funding Match
items.description: Help need to match a sub-prime profile to the lowest-barrier GoKapital product and generate a My Best Funding Options Dashboard.
items.use_case: Need to match a sub-prime profile to the lowest-barrier GoKapital product.

internal.core_logic: Maps FICO: None->MCA, 500->Term Loan, 580->Equipment, 650->Hard Money.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Equipment Payment Estimator
items.description: Help need to estimate monthly costs for financing business equipment with bad credit and generate a Equipment Financing Estimate (Quote).
items.use_case: Need to estimate monthly costs for financing business equipment with bad credit.

internal.core_logic: Applies 6% to 35% cost range based on low-FICO (580+) equipment financing rates.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Lender-Readiness Score
items.description: Help assessing profiles against full criteria to create a 60-day action plan for unbankable leads and generate a Your 60-Day Funding Action Plan.
items.use_case: Assessing profiles against full criteria to create a 60-day action plan for unbankable leads.

internal.core_logic: Assigns 0-100 score and specific gap tasks (e.g., "Get 2 More Tradelines").
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Competitor Rejection Analyzer
items.description: Help rejected by algorithm-only competitors (e.g., OnDeck, BlueVine) and generate a Your GoKapital Backdoor Pass (Guide).
items.use_case: Rejected by algorithm-only competitors (e.g., OnDeck, BlueVine).

internal.core_logic: Maps competitor's rigid algorithm constraints to GoKapital's flexible human brokerage.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Invoice-to-Cash Flow Gap Analyzer
items.description: Help need to calculate exact cash runway before a late client payment destroys them and generate a Your Cash Runway & Survival Score.
items.use_case: Need to calculate exact cash runway before a late client payment destroys them.

internal.core_logic: Cash Runway = (Cash on Hand / Monthly Expenses) * 30. Triggers alert if Runway < Payment Days.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Gig Worker "Back on the Road" Calculator
items.description: Help vehicle is in the shop; daily lost income exceeds the cost of financing the repair and generate a Your Daily Lost Income Counter (Widget).
items.use_case: Vehicle is in the shop; daily lost income exceeds the cost of financing the repair.

internal.core_logic: Lost Income = Daily Earnings * Days Out. Compares to Repair Cost to justify emergency funding.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Tax Payment Advance Estimator
items.description: Help need quarterly tax funding to avoid IRS installment plan penalties and generate a IRS Payment Plan vs. Advance Comparison.
items.use_case: Need quarterly tax funding to avoid IRS installment plan penalties.

internal.core_logic: Estimated Tax Owed = (Gross - Expenses) * Est. Tax Rate. Compares loan cost vs IRS penalty.
internal.output_artifact: IRS Payment Plan vs. Advance Comparison
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Material Cost Inflation Tracker
items.description: Help material prices surged since the bid; need to cover the budget gap and generate a Your Material Budget Gap Dashboard.
items.use_case: Material prices surged since the bid; need to cover the budget gap.

internal.core_logic: Applies indexed inflation rates (e.g., copper +12%) to original budget to display "Funding Gap".
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Premium Finance "Double Commission" Calc
items.description: Help agents losing renewals to cash flow want to see how funding clients makes them more money and generate a Your Revenue Retention Opportunity Report.
items.use_case: Agents losing renewals to cash flow want to see how funding clients makes them more money.

internal.core_logic: (Clients Lost * Premium * Comm Rate) + Funding Commission = New Revenue.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Meet or Beat" Rate Comparison Tool
items.description: Help want to verify GoKapital's $500 guarantee against a current MCA offer and generate a $500 Guarantee Qualification Letter.
items.use_case: Want to verify GoKapital's $500 guarantee against a current MCA offer.

internal.core_logic: Standardizes input factor rates/APRs. If GoKapital beats by 5%+, qualifies for guarantee.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Equipment ROI & Payment Calculator
items.description: Help checking if new equipment revenue outpaces the monthly financing payment and generate a Equipment Investment Profitability Forecast.
items.use_case: Checking if new equipment revenue outpaces the monthly financing payment.

internal.core_logic: If Expected Additional Monthly Revenue > Estimated Payment + 20%, outputs Green Light.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Restaurant "Walk-In Emergency" Tool
items.description: Help critical kitchen equipment (walk-in fridge) fails, causing daily spoilage/lost sales and generate a Emergency Equipment Replacement Estimate.
items.use_case: Critical kitchen equipment (walk-in fridge) fails, causing daily spoilage/lost sales.

internal.core_logic: Urgency Score = Daily Revenue Lost * 7 days. If > Replacement Cost, triggers emergency path.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Payroll Gap Bridge Estimator
items.description: Help need exact funding required to hit Friday payroll while waiting on receivables and generate a Friday Payroll Protection Plan (PDF).
items.use_case: Need exact funding required to hit Friday payroll while waiting on receivables.

internal.core_logic: Total Payroll Amount - Current Cash Available = Funding Needed. Suggests Term/MCA.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Embedded Finance Widget
items.description: Help partners need a white-label pre-qualification tool embedded on their own websites and generate a Embeddable White-Label Widget.
items.use_case: Partners need a white-label pre-qualification tool embedded on their own websites.

internal.core_logic: Collects Revenue/Need/Contact and routes directly to GoKapital CRM with partner tracking.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Wholesaler/Real Estate "Deal Analyzer" Pro
items.description: Help needs to run full deal math AND generate a proof of funds instantly and generate a Deal Package with Pre-Qualification Letter.
items.use_case: Needs to run full deal math AND generate a proof of funds instantly.

internal.core_logic: (ARV * 0.75) - Rehab. If margin >15%, auto-generates conditional POF letter for property.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Turndown Retrieval" Lead Magnet Template
items.description: Help need a ready-made asset to hand to rejected applicants to salvage the lead and generate a Co-Branded Alternative Funding PDF.
items.use_case: Need a ready-made asset to hand to rejected applicants to salvage the lead.

internal.core_logic: Pre-written explanations of bank denials combined with partner's custom referral link.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Daily Pay Commission" Calculator
items.description: Help want to compare GoKapital's daily payouts against traditional Net-30 affiliate programs and generate a Your Daily Income Simulator.
items.use_case: Want to compare GoKapital's daily payouts against traditional Net-30 affiliate programs.

internal.core_logic: (Weekly Deals * Deal Size * Commission) / 5 days = Daily Income.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Supply House Partnership Landing Page
items.description: Help agents need a digital asset to pitch supply houses on offering contractor financing and generate a Customizable Static HTML Page.
items.use_case: Agents need a digital asset to pitch supply houses on offering contractor financing.

internal.core_logic: Pre-built "Help Your Customers Buy More" HTML form to capture supply house contacts.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: Credit Incubator" Roadmap Generator
items.description: Help needs a 60-90 day rehabilitation plan after being rejected for all standard funding and generate a Your Path to Funding Approval PDF.
items.use_case: Needs a 60-90 day rehabilitation plan after being rejected for all standard funding.

internal.core_logic: Identifies specific gaps (e.g., need 3 more months in biz, 2 more tradelines) and builds step plan.
internal.output_artifact: Your Path to Funding Approval PDF
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Stockout Death Spiral" Estimator
items.description: Help underestimating the true cost of stocking out (lost sales + lost SEO ranking) and generate a "Damage Report" PDF.
items.use_case: Underestimating the true cost of stocking out (lost sales + lost SEO ranking).

internal.core_logic: (Daily Rev * Days Out) + Estimated Re-Ranking Ad Spend + CLV Loss.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Equity-Saver Shield (VC vs. 8fig)
items.description: Help thinking VC money is "free" without realizing the millions lost in equity dilution at exit and generate a Founder Ownership Dashboard.
items.use_case: Thinking VC money is "free" without realizing the millions lost in equity dilution at exit.

internal.core_logic: (Exit Value * Equity %) - (8fig Cost of Capital) = Total Savings.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Boat-to-Bank" Gap Analyzer
items.description: Help cash is "dead" and inaccessible while inventory is trapped on cargo ships and generate a Cash Gap Timeline Infographic.
items.use_case: Cash is "dead" and inaccessible while inventory is trapped on cargo ships.

internal.core_logic: Maps the "Dead Zone" days between factory "Cash Out" and Amazon "First Dollar In".
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The MCA "Shark" Auditor
items.description: Help merchant Cash Advances hide their triple-digit APRs behind opaque "Factor Rates" and generate a Audit Certificate.
items.use_case: Merchant Cash Advances hide their triple-digit APRs behind opaque "Factor Rates".

internal.core_logic: Converts Factor Rate and Daily Holdback % into an effective annualized APR.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Viral Hit" Stress Test
items.description: Help a viral video spikes demand 5x, leading to an immediate stockout and brand death and generate a Supply Chain Fragility Score.
items.use_case: A viral video spikes demand 5x, leading to an immediate stockout and brand death.

internal.core_logic: Stock / (Monthly Units * 5). Fails stress test if result < Supplier Lead Time.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Asset-Light" ROI Multiplier
items.description: Help unsure whether to allocate capital to inventory replenishment or Facebook Ads and generate a Capital Allocation Map.
items.use_case: Unsure whether to allocate capital to inventory replenishment or Facebook Ads.

internal.core_logic: Compares the compounding ROI of flipping inventory against one-time ad attribution.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Amazon Payout" Bridge Predictor
items.description: Help amazon's 14-day payout hold kills the ability to pay the next manufacturing deposit and generate a Payout Bridge Checklist.
items.use_case: Amazon's 14-day payout hold kills the ability to pay the next manufacturing deposit.

internal.core_logic: Calculates the gap between Amazon's disbursement schedule and the factory's PO due date.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The Q4 "War-Room" PO Planner
items.description: Help ordering inventory too late for major events (Black Friday, Chinese New Year) and generate a Q4 Logistics Calendar (.ics/PDF).
items.use_case: Ordering inventory too late for major events (Black Friday, Chinese New Year).

internal.core_logic: Back-calculates the exact date a PO must be funded to land 14 days before the sales event.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Ghost Revenue" Interceptor
items.description: Help blindness to the massive invisible revenue lost from historical stockouts and generate a Ghost Revenue Report.
items.use_case: Blindness to the massive invisible revenue lost from historical stockouts.

internal.core_logic: Days Out of Stock * Avg Daily Sales = Ghost Revenue.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Landed Cost" Profit Leak Finder
items.description: Help ignoring hidden logistics costs (storage, shipping spikes) resulting in false profit views and generate a Profit Leakage Checklist.
items.use_case: Ignoring hidden logistics costs (storage, shipping spikes) resulting in false profit views.

internal.core_logic: Revenue - (Factory Price + Shipping + Storage + Ad CPA) = Net Net Margin.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Exit Value" Accelerator
items.description: Help business valuation/EBITDA is suppressed because of historical stockout periods and generate a Exit Strategy Road Map.
items.use_case: Business valuation/EBITDA is suppressed because of historical stockout periods.

internal.core_logic: (New EBITDA * Multiple) - Current Valuation = Valuation Increase.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Air Freight" Panic Button
items.description: Help deciding if 5x air freight costs are worth it to avoid a 45-day sea freight stockout and generate a Logistics Triage Card.
items.use_case: Deciding if 5x air freight costs are worth it to avoid a 45-day sea freight stockout.

internal.core_logic: If (Profit * Days Saved) > (Air Cost - Sea Cost), recommendation is to fly it.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Big Box" Trap Simulator (Net-90)
items.description: Help landing a huge retail PO but going bankrupt fulfilling it due to Net-90 payment terms and generate a Wholesale Readiness Scorecard.
items.use_case: Landing a huge retail PO but going bankrupt fulfilling it due to Net-90 payment terms.

internal.core_logic: Plots Cash Balance over 90 days. If the line crosses zero, seller dies before getting paid.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Zombie SKU" Hunter
items.description: Help 80% of operating cash is tied up in 20% of dead inventory that refuses to sell and generate a Dead Stock Hitlist.
items.use_case: 80% of operating cash is tied up in 20% of dead inventory that refuses to sell.

internal.core_logic: Marks SKU as "Zombie" if supply >6 months and margin contribution <10%.
internal.routing_note: Do not expose affiliate partner/provider branding on the public front end.

items.name: The "Ad Cost" Inflation Forecaster
